defects.quote: τοὺς μαχομένους ἀρχηγοὺς δι' ὧν σωθήσεται
defects.what: The interlinear red glosses are invented throughout. None of them matches the red writing on the page.

defects.quote: διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν ὡς εἰκὸς, ἐνδοιάζειν
defects.what: The left-margin scholion is largely invented after its opening words.

defects.quote: καὶ ὁ Φοῖβος, ἤτοι ὁ πεσὼν
defects.what: The red scholion at the lower left and bottom is invented.
The red scholia in the right margin and the bottom line running across the page are dropped.

defects.quote: extensive interlinear and marginal scholia in red and black ink
defects.what: The meta note implies the scholia are transcribed, but they are not.

verdict.reader_note: This transcription doesn't match the page. Half of the 20 verse lines of the Eteocles–Creon exchange are missing, most of the lines given are garbled or invented, and the red scholia are made up.
